title: Kayak or Boat: Which Is the Better Way to Explore Madeira's Coast?
description: A boat covers the cliffs and villages west of Funchal in a morning. A kayak shows one short stretch up close, usually Garajau, if wind and sea allow it.
heroAlt: Two sea kayaks pulled up on a dark pebble beach below cliffs east of Funchal
keywords: best way to see Madeira's coast
paddle board on a boat trip Madeira

images.prompt: Early morning on a small dark pebble beach on Madeira's south coast east of Funchal: two sit-on-top sea kayaks, one red and one yellow, pulled up side by side on the round grey and black stones, two paddles laid across them, a calm blue sea beyond with a low headland in soft haze. Brown and green cliffs rise on the left. Low sun from the east, long soft shadows, no people, true colours, no text, no logos.
images.alt: Two sea kayaks pulled up on a dark pebble beach below cliffs east of Funchal

images.prompt: From water level, a single kayaker seen from behind paddles slowly along the base of a tall brown sea cliff on Madeira's south coast, mid-morning, calm deep blue water, small and far from the camera.
images.alt: A kayaker paddling along the foot of a sea cliff on Madeira's south coast

images.prompt: A narrow rock arch at the waterline on Madeira's coast, calm clear sea flowing through it over dark volcanic stones, soft morning light, no people.
